## Architecture Review Checklist
- [ ] File is saved under `docs/adr/` using the naming format `XXXX-short-title.md`
- [ ] At least two viable alternatives were evaluated with clear pros and cons
- [ ] Security, privacy, and data retention (ZDR) impacts are documented
- [ ] FinOps / token cost attribution and rate-limiting impacts are addressed
- [ ] Migration path and rollback plan are clearly defined
- [ ] `README.md` index table has been updated with this ADR
